crew.name: Bini
crew.alt: Bini pouring latte art into an Aggüdo cup behind the bar
crew.bio: Bini has crafted over 45,000 cups of coffee — enough to fill a small swimming pool. With that kind of experience, he can spot a bad espresso shot from across the room. His precision, speed, and passion make every cup at Isaiah Café taste like it was made just for you.

crew.name: Jayme
crew.alt: Jayme glazing a tray of croissants in the café kitchen
crew.bio: Jayme brings excellence, energy, and artistry to every cup and pastry she makes. A dedicated UCalgary student and a talented dance teacher, she moves through the café with the same rhythm and precision she brings to the studio. Her commitment to quality shows in every latte, every interaction, and every moment she spends making Isaiah Café shine.

crew.name: Paige
crew.alt: Paige serving a latte and croissant sandwich at the counter
crew.bio: Paige is one of Isaiah Café's strongest baristas, known for her high energy, warm customer care, and consistently excellent service. She brings confidence, speed, and positivity to every shift, creating the kind of welcoming experience that keeps guests coming back.
crew.favorite: Apple cinnamon muffin & iced white chocolate mocha
